# MSE Supplies LLC

> Global supplier of advanced materials, nanomaterials, laboratory equipment, and analytical services for materials science research and battery development.

MSE Supplies specializes in high-purity chemicals, evaporation materials, nanoparticles, single crystals, and specialized lab equipment for academic and industrial research. The company offers both standard catalog items and custom solutions through its MSE PRO product line.

## Key Topics

- Advanced Materials
- Materials Science
- Battery Research
- Lithium-Ion Battery Materials
- Graphene and Graphene Oxide
- Nanoparticles and Nanomaterials
- High-Purity Chemicals
- Sputtering Targets
- Thin-Film Deposition
- Single Crystals and Wafers
- Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD)
- Powder Processing
- Laboratory Equipment
- MSE PRO Products
- Solid Electrolytes

## Core Products & Materials

- [Supplies and Products for Material Scientists](https://www.msesupplies.com/pages/mse-supplies-products): Main product catalog overview for materials science research and lab supplies.
- [Lithium Ion Battery Materials and Supplies](https://www.msesupplies.com/collections/lithium-ion-battery-supplies-equipment-materials): Lithium-ion battery materials, supplies, and equipment for battery R&D projects.
- [Graphene and Graphene Oxide](https://www.msesupplies.com/collections/graphene-and-graphene-oxide): Graphene and graphene oxide products for nanotech research applications.
- [Metal Nanoparticles and Nanomaterials](https://www.msesupplies.com/collections/nanoparticles-nano-powder-materials): Metal nanoparticles and nanomaterials including carbon nanotubes for research.
- [High Purity Inorganic Chemicals](https://www.msesupplies.com/collections/high-purity-inorganic-chemicals): High-purity inorganic chemicals catalog for research and industrial applications.
- [MSE PRO Organic Chemicals](https://www.msesupplies.com/collections/mse-pro-organic-chemicals): High-purity organic chemicals including battery electrolyte materials.

## Deposition & Thin-Film Materials

- [Sputtering Targets](https://www.msesupplies.com/collections/sputtering-targets): Custom sputtering targets for thin-film deposition and materials research.
- [Lithium Fluoride Evaporation Materials](https://www.msesupplies.com/collections/evaporation-materials): High-purity lithium fluoride evaporation materials for thin film deposition.
- [Single Crystals, Wafers and Substrates](https://www.msesupplies.com/collections/single-crystals-wafers-and-substrates): Single crystals, wafers, and substrates including silicon carbide for research.

## Laboratory Equipment & Systems

- [Atomic Layer Deposition ALD Equipment](https://www.msesupplies.com/collections/atomic-layer-deposition-ald-equipment): ALD equipment including benchtop systems from Anric Technologies.
- [Arc Melting and Quenching Equipment](https://www.msesupplies.com/collections/arc-melting-and-quenching-equipment): Arc melting and quenching equipment for materials research and development.
- [Powder Processing Equipment](https://www.msesupplies.com/collections/powder-processing-with-ball-mill-media): Ball mills, roller mills, and grinding equipment for powder processing.
- [Analytical Balances & Scales](https://www.msesupplies.com/collections/analytical-balances-scales): Analytical and precision balances for laboratory and industrial applications.
- [Air Protection Products](https://www.msesupplies.com/collections/air-protection-products): Laboratory air protection equipment including biosafety cabinets and fume hoods.

## Specialized Materials

- [Phosphors and Luminescent Materials](https://www.msesupplies.com/collections/luminescent-powders-and-phosphors): Luminescent materials and phosphors including LED phosphors for research needs.
- [High-Quality Zeolite Molecular Sieves](https://www.msesupplies.com/collections/molecular-sieves): High-quality zeolite molecular sieves for purification and adsorbent applications.
